rationale.reason: Stationary mechanical mineral/cold-glass machine tools fit 8464; mineral crushing, hot-glass forming and metalworking are excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR covers manufacture of complete stationary machine tools for conventional mechanical cutting, drilling, milling, grinding or edging of stone, ceramics, cured concrete and similar mineral solids, or cold machining of flat glass. It includes the declared installed bed/frame, spindle and axis drives, controls, guards, workholding and delivered integral water/vacuum systems. Declare one material-working configuration and its delivery gate. Exclude laser, water-jet and other non-conventional material-removal machines already covered by their material PCR, metal-working machines, mineral crushing/mixing plant, glass melting or hot forming, portable hand tools, separately sold tooling and components, optical-glass finishing and asbestos-cement-specific configurations. Evidence here does not establish those specialized methods. Installation, routine customer workpieces, water, sludge, dust, tool replacement, maintenance and end-of-life are outside machinery manufacture. Factory acceptance trials are included when actually performed and recorded. No machining service or complete factory-line model is included.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Configured mineral-solid mechanical saws and machining machines; cold flat-glass drilling, grinding and edging machines
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Non-conventional removal machines; metal-working machine tools; crushing plant; hot-glass forming; optical or asbestos-specific configurations; hand tools, separate tools and services
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New accepted empty machine at factory delivery gate; transport packaging separately inventoried

authored_review_metadata.semantic_boundary_decision: New conventional mechanical mineral-solid and cold flat-glass machine-tool manufacturing record. Existing material non-conventional-removal PCR covers laser/water-jet/etc. and material metal-working PCRs target metal/carbides/cermets; no duplication. Excludes crushing/mixing plant, hot glass, hand tools, optical and asbestos-specific configurations pending separate evidence, customer operation, spares and machining services. Bounded scope is narrower than CPC title. Retained scaffold is read-only and no mapping acceptance is asserted.
